title: mission.director_phase_change
description: M9: emitted at every M9 7-phase mission director transition (setup → prep → launch → build_up → sustain_peak → relax → debrief). Distinct from the legacy mission.phase_changed event so M10's viewer + M11's HUD can subscribe to the M9 pacer without parsing the M7 4-phase stream. Carries from/to/cause + the duration_seconds of the just-completed phase so dwell-aware UI can render time-in-phase strips.
